test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. You have to consider these statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts. Decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the given statements.

**Statements:**

Few calciums are aldehydes

All aldehydes are rubidiums

All rubidiums are hydrogens

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some hydrogens are aldehydes

(II) Some rubidiums are aldehydes

(III) All aldehydes are hydrogens

options.text: Either conclusion I or III follows
All conclusions I, II and III follow

solution:
Statements:

Few calciums are aldehydes

All aldehydes are rubidiums

All rubidiums are hydrogens

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24bd0c8f0419da3502f7ba6144737cb67a945966d02f8c645041829b10433217.png] 

Conclusions: 

I. Some hydrogens are aldehydes → **True **(As All rubidiums are hydrogens and All aldehydes are rubidiums . So definitely some hydrogens are aldehydes. )

II. Some rubidiums are aldehydes → **Ture**(All aldehydes are rubidiums, so definitely Some rubidiums are aldehyde)

III. All aldehydes are hydrogens → **True **(As All aldehydes are rubidiums, and All rubidiums are hydrogens . hence definitely All rubidiums are hydrogens)

**Hence, 'All conclusions I, ll and III follow'.**
